- **Dependencies and scope.** T14, T4b and T16 are present in the audited ancestry at `8b647e96`, `ed90f34f` and `8b2722fc`. Plan 0007 T17 lists both calc modules, both golden test modules, both new fixture globs, the calc lock, both verification records, and the changelog. [Plan task](../../../packages/eng-harness/docs/plans/0007-model-edit-cycle.md#L604) · [Registry](../../../ops/remaining-tasks.json#L3535) · [Risk map](../../../.gate/risk-map.yml#L5)
- **AC39 behavior.** Both calcs can adopt the `model_diff._section` input pattern, keeping `model.sections/1` reference metadata and checking a supplied payload's reference. The change-set check can preserve `complete=False` from a supplied incomplete section and retain the existing empty-selection detail for calls with sections. For omitted sections, its area-kind map is empty and a selection carrying `area_kind` produces `EMPTY_SELECTION` with the unread-area-kinds reason. The effects calc can use its existing material and thickness `set` path when sections are absent and check model and revision across loads, restraints and any supplied sections. This requires no new engineering values or defaults. [AC39](../../../packages/eng-harness/docs/specs/0007-model-edit-cycle.md#L297) · [Spec §§4.4.1–4.4.2](../../../packages/eng-harness/docs/specs/0007-model-edit-cycle.md#L419) · [Optional reference precedent](../../../packages/eng-harness/src/eng_harness/calcs/model_diff.py#L55) · [Reference validation](../../../packages/eng-contract/src/eng_contract/_validation.py#L91)
- **Test-first.** Both planned `test_sections_absent` nodes can load hand-derived fixtures under `check-no-sections-*.json` and `effects-no-sections-*.json`, omitting `sections` from both input and refs. The existing loader permits those omissions, and each calc's required input field makes its corresponding node red on the base. The scoped test modules own the `STEMS` inventories, which can expand without changing existing test functions or golden expectations. The effects property test samples a fixed set of existing cases. The merged B-547 lock diff moved only the check and effects hashes because `expected_effects` imports `ANSWER_FIELD` from the check. The calc sources and hash tooling are unchanged since that merge, and the effects module has no other downstream registered calc imports. Both scoped draft verification records refer to their lock entries for the hash and can record the new method behavior and hand-derived cases. Both calcs stay at v1.
